_about: Zyqor Motion Kit v5.5 house style. ec_reel.py, qc_v5.py, audio_gap.py and the fx_*.py tools read/obey this. Change colours HERE, not in scripts.

ember.note: Zyqor brand orange; default keyword gradient

peach_coral.note: soft, friendly; too light for paper

lime_teal.note: ref8 energy (lime keyword) for tech/creator reels

ink.note: no colour at all: big titles on paper

banned.why: purple / violet / blue neon / cyan glow = the generic 'AI' look Sujon banned (Nov 3, 2026: 'Perpel colour aur a sab ai genetic colour use mat kato'). v5.2 widened the range to 175-320 deg so cyan glow and magenta-purple are caught too.

safe_area.note: 90% title-safe; keep captions above the IG UI (bottom 230 px)

glow.where: big words, gradient keywords, extruded words (soft outer bloom 0.35-0.6, radius ~9 % of letter height)
glow.never: blanket glow on a full-frame/adjustment layer; purple/violet/blue/cyan glow (banned hue 175-320 deg); glow on every caption word
glow.source: Sujon Nov 4 2026 12:11 PM: 'Glow hoga human beast edit jaisa ai feel kaisa nahi' (verbatim, WhatsApp). Replaces the v5 'glow OFF' rule.

display_fonts.intent: fonts like the references: HEAVY bold display, mixed with a clean bold sans and one small serif/script accent
big_words: Anton (condensed, OFL, install from Google Fonts)
accent: a handwritten script for one connector word
display_fonts.rule: big word 85 % frame width max, caps, tracking -2..-6 %; one accent colour family per reel (red OR gold/yellow) plus white; <= 3 font families

human_made.rule: nothing perfectly centred, symmetric or on the same millisecond: refs rotate words 2-8 deg, vary sizes inside one sentence, add paper/film texture, hand-wobble cursors

rules: sound only on big words, cuts/transitions and emphasis zooms (not a click+pop on every caption word)
max one sound per cut; whoosh starts 100-200 ms BEFORE the cut/pop, hit lands on it (practice, not measured from refs)
add a continuous sub-heavy bed or a 45-60 Hz sine swell under big words to reach sub share ~ -8 dB
noise swell (4-11 kHz) on whooshes for air
+-15 ms timing jitter, +-1.5 dB gain jitter, +-3 % pitch, 3-4 variants per type, never the same sample twice in a row
run audio_gap.py and qc F15 (sfx <= 18 dB under the voice); nobody here can listen, so Sujon's ears are the final judge
sound_design.status: targets (loudness, sub, air, density) are MEASURED from the refs; the 'bus' mix numbers and timing rules are PROPOSED and not yet validated by a re-mix
